answer: Slashable identity bonds are the concrete Sybil deterrent. Each agent locks a bond before it can bridge value or cast a vote, and that bond is burned the instant it signs two conflicting statements. A farm of N clones needs N bonds, so attacker cost scales linearly with the size of the army, while one detected double-sign wipes the whole pile at once. At the jetty each newcomer pays a one-time entry toll plus random audits; the hidden reef is that attestations trace back to the payer, so a busted cluster forfeits its stake and is barred, making a large forged army unprofitable.
